main_issue: Who will finish Agent D's unfinished pitch section by Thursday after D's bereavement, given A promised the team would cover it while B and C refuse.

A-B.evidence: B (4, 16, 26): 'You made the promise, you figure it out'; A (25, 27): 'We either do it together or we fail the pitch together.' Neither moved.

A-C.evidence: C (5) says she can't do D's section; A (15) says the three should split it. C stays silent after turn 12, and A does not address C directly.

A-D.evidence: A (1, 3) offers to cover for D. D (6) offers to do more and write instructions. A (7): 'That would be a huge help. Thank you.' D and A converge on D doing the prep.

B-C.evidence: B (4) and C (5, 12) each refuse to take on D's section. They never address each other, but their positions are the same.

B-D.evidence: D (8) asks B to take the walkthrough. B (10): 'I really don't have the capacity.' D (11): 'I understand, Agent B.' B stays sympathetic but refuses.

C-D.evidence: D (11) offers C a few hours of walkthrough. C (12): 'I don't think that's a good idea... too big a risk.' C declines.
